Boundaries.Name: immediate-pooled-conversion
Boundaries.Contract: Immediate conversion publishes converter and cleanup failures after disposing untransferred response ownership. A supplied failure-only FinalOwner also owns input inspection and retry counts. Without one, input failures belong to the underlying send. Borrowed conversion can suppress observation; success rents no observation.

Boundaries.Name: pending-pooled-conversion
Boundaries.Contract: Pending conversion owns the same errors as immediate conversion. Clear captured source fields, finish response disposal and complete the failure-only FinalOwner before publishing the caller result. Preserve original exceptions, canceled status and response ownership transfer; no universal ValueTask wrapper.
